36309: This character page is set to represent and list all narrators, which haven't been given a visual representation of themselves in their respective work.
122443: Riko is the only child of the legendary White Whistle Lyza, the Annihilator. When she was two, her mother began her last dive to the bottom of the abyss. She was left under the care of the Belchero Orphanage.
122444: Reg is a robotic being who appears to be a little boy. His actual age, origins, and even name are unknown because he cannot recall anything about his life before his encounter with Riko. He is named after a dog Riko used to have.
122445: Nanachi is a Narehate — a person who’s survived the 6th layer’s Curse of the Abyss and has been left deformed as a result.
122463: Bondrewd is a legendary white whistle delver who has made many great discoveries about the secrets of the Abyss.
122464: Ouzen the Immovable is an elite White Whistle who lives at the Observation Base on the second level of the Abyss where she commands a small team of cave raiders known as "The Layabouts." Ouzen was a mentor and a close friend of Riko's mother Lyza.
122465: Lyza the Annihilator is a legendary White Whistle who accomplished many great discoveries about the secrets of the Abyss. She is Ozen's apprentice and Riko's mother.
122466: Prushka is the adoptive daughter of the White Whistle Delver Bondrewd. She lives with him at the Forward Operation Base. Prushka is a cheerful and amiable girl who loves her adoptive father very much.
122748: Nat is an orphan from the Belchero Orphanage in the town at the edge of the Abyss, Orth. Like all the children of the orphanage, he's studied to become a Delver since a young age and attained the rank of Red Whistle Delver after his first descent.
122749: Shiggy is an orphan from the Belchero Orphanage in the town at the edge of the Abyss, Orth. Like all the children of the orphanage, he has studied to become a Delver since a young age and attained the rank of Red Whistle Delver after his first descent.
123145: Ozen's assistant and a Blue Whistle Diver.
123185: Hablog (called Habo-san by Riko and the other children) is a well-known Black Whistle Delver and was the person who delivered Lyza's White Whistle and final notes to the surface.
123188: Jiruo is a Moon Whistle Delver who serves as a teacher for Apprentice Delvers from the Belchero Orphanage in the town of Orth. While he works as an instructor for the children, he is also largely responsible for their upbringing and well-being.
125877: Mitty is an amorphous Narehate who lived with Nanachi on the 4th layer of the Abyss. Mitty had been a regular human girl in the past and her appearance changed due to the result of the ascension from the 6th layer.
127655: Vueko, whose full name is Vueroeruko, is a mysterious woman who was chained by her neck in a deep pit of sludge beneath Ilblu before Riko set her free.
153051: Black Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.
158387: Mio is a nurse that visits Orth on a merchant caravan.
158388: Laffi is Hablog's wife and owner of a shop in Orth. She is well-liked by Riko and the other orphans, who frequent her shop. Riko often using her telescope to observe Abyssal wildlife.
158389: A Black Whistle who had a chance encounter with Reg in the 4th layer.
158390: Blue Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.
158391: Moon Whistle and a member of Ozen's expedition team. He is currently stationed at the Seeker Camp in the 2nd layer.
158393: Belchero is the director of the Belchero Orphanage. She imposed strict rules within the Academy and the orphanage. Belchero has black hair with white strains in it, which ends in a topknot, and two long curls down each ear.
160733: Faputa is referred to as "Princess of the Narehate" by the inhabitants of the Narehate Village Ilblu within the inviolable 6th layer of the Abyss. She is described by Majikaja as "the embodiment of value", and is incredibly highly regarded by all the Narehate in the village.
161856: Torka is Lyza's husband and Riko's father. He was one of the members of a survey team ordered from the government, with a special mission to retrieve the Greater Artifact Unheard Bell from the 4th layer of the Abyss.
161973: Ilim is one of the children brought down in the depths of the abyss by white whistle Bondrewd, together with Mitty and Nanachi. Later on, it's highly likely that she is one of the Narehate seen in the sixth layer of the abyss.
169306: Belaf is one of the Three Sages of Ilblu.
171661: Wazukyan is one of the Three Sages of the Village of Ilblu.
183025: Irumyuui is the infertile daughter of the chief of a tribe living inside the rim of the Abyss. The tribe feared she was cursed, due to her infertility, and sent her as tribute into the Abyss with the Ganja.
183026: Gaburoon is a large robot in the service of Faputa and capable of independent thoughts and actions. They are the Interference Unit of the 6th layer, which it referred to as the Bell Tower Layer. They are capable of speech, but usually just make a "gooon" noise.
189907: Gueira is a member of the Umbra Hands who is stationed at Ido Front. He was in charge of taking care of Prushka as a child.
199683: Meinya is Prushka's pet given to her as a present from her adoptive father, Bondrewd, as her 10th birthday present. Its name is a result of Prushka not being able to pronounce "Meinastilim" when it was given to her.
217769: Enbelietz is a Narehate in Ilblu. They are a kind of merchant.
217771: Majikaja, or sometimes just Kaja, is a Narehate living in the village Ilblu. They can understand and communicate using human speech, though they sometimes forget words, and sometimes refers to themself in third person.
217772: Mepopohon is a Narehate in Ilblu. During their stay in Ilblu, Riko rents a room in their lodge. The meal they made gave Riko bad indigestion.
217773: Juroimoh is a Narehate created by Ilblu itself, based on signals it received from Vueko during her imprisonment, and the embodiment of its will. Juroimoh is one of the Three Sages of Ilblu. He has the same name as Vueko's adoptive father, who used to abuse her.
217774: Moogie is a friendly worker at the restaurant Riko visited in Ilblu. They explained the nature of Ilblu's language to Riko and taught her a few phrases, as well as pointing Riko towards where she might be able to find Reg and Nanachi.
217775: Maaa is a Narehate in Ilblu. Whether she has an actual name is unknown. Due to the fact that she can only say "Maaa" Riko took to calling her that, which she doesn't seem to mind. Apparently none of the other Narehate in Ilblu can understand Maaa either.
233014: Pakkoyan is a Narehate in Ilblu and one of the original first inhabitants of it as a former member of Ganja.
237657: Srajo "The Obscure", is a legendary White Whistle Delver of the Abyss. Since she is a White Whistle, she is presumed to have made amazing discoveries within the pit and retrieved Artifacts that have changed the world.
237658: Wakuna "The Chosen", also known as the "Lord of Guidance", is one of the legendary White Whistle Delvers in the Abyss, and is therefore presumed to have made outstanding discoveries down in the deep. He made his "Last Dive" to the 6th layer some time before Riko's journey.
277611: Gyarike is a member of the Umbra Hands, also known as Ashen Gyarike due to his flamethrower Artifact. Umbra Hands with white coats, like Gyarike, are combat types equipped with powerful Artifacts.
294665: One of the Ganja members that travelled to the Abyss.
294667: A merchant in Ilblu who values all sorts of delver gear. He is one of the original members of Ganja.
